assumptions.castFormula: necro: bonebolt = 0.72/aps, blight = 0.7/aps (verified in code UN.start, NOT sqrt); all other skills fixed dur (raise 0.6, decrepify 0.6, corpsex 0.55, golem 0.8, colossus 0.9, sacrifice 0.45)

essencePerHit.extraTargetRaw: Zb.hit[1]=1 / hit[2]=0.3: consumer is server-side, meaning unverified

assumptions.dmgUnit: % of average weapon hit (avg(dmgMin,dmgMax) x dmgMult), single target
assumptions.servantDmgAssumption: skeleton 30% weapon every 1.3 s, scales with player hit (server-side, unverified)

bonebolt.essenceGain: 4 per cast that hits (Zb.hit[0]); +1 per extra target hit with nc_bonebolt R2 (max 4); +6 per monster dying within 12 m (any source)
bonebolt.utility: essence generator, LMB, cast scales dur/aps
bonebolt.useWhen: filler: no other rule fires, or essence < reserve; aim at cluster centre (splash 1.8 m, 2.4 m with nc_thorns R1)

rankScaling.nc_oath_plague (50): plague 25%/0.5s for 2 s on main target

blight.utility: rips 1 corpse from the living target (even bosses); RMB but cast = 0.7/aps (code uses /aps, NOT sqrt)
blight.useWhen: essence >= cost + reserve && (corpsesNear < 2 && (raise wanted || corpsex ready) || enemiesWithin2.5mOfTarget >= 2 || target is elite/boss)

raise.utility: up to 2 corpses within 4.5 m -> skeletons (30% weapon every 1.3 s = 23.1%/s each, 28.8%/s with nc_lich), heal 2% life per corpse
raise.useWhen: skeletons < cap && corpsesWithin4.5mOfCursor >= 1 && essence >= 15 (top priority; 2 corpses ideal)
raise.note: dmgPerEssence assumes 2 skeletons living 30 s (assumption, lifetime is server-side)

rankScaling.nc_lich (14+): +25% servant speed, 3 essence per servant kill

decrepify.utility: 8 s curse: -25% enemy dmg, slow 3 s, corpses last ~2x
decrepify.useWhen: off cd && (enemiesInRadius4.5 >= 3 || elite/boss in range || hp < 60%)

rankScaling.R3 (lvl>=24): 15% fear 1 s per hit on cursed

corpsex.utility: up to 3 corpses within 5 m of cursor each blow 200% in 3.5 m (a target within 3.5 m of k corpses takes k x 200%), heal 2%/corpse
corpsex.useWhen: off cd && corpsesWithin5mOfCursor >= 1 && enemiesWithin3.5mOfThoseCorpses >= 2 && (skeletons == cap || corpses > needed for raise); solo target: only if skeletons == cap

rankScaling.R3 (lvl>=20): plague 3 s, jumps to 2 neighbours on death

fleshgolem.utility: permanent golem, slam 90% weapon r2.6 every 2 s (45%/s per target), stun 0.4 s
fleshgolem.useWhen: no golem alive && essence >= cost (out of combat preferred: essence never decays)

colossus.utility: ult: 3 slams x 320% r6 (1 s rise, 1.1 s apart), stun 1 s each, leaves 4 corpses
colossus.useWhen: off cd && (enemiesInRadius6 >= 3 || boss/elite) ; follow with raise/corpsex on the 4 corpses

sacrifice.utility: every skeleton bursts 150% r3 (1 hit per enemy), -25% skeleton endurance (worn ones become corpses)

agony.utility: choice vs decrepify: 35% of damage taken by target hits enemies within 6 m, 6 s

roll.utility: 0.6 s invulnerable, slows 2 s in 2.6 m, raises 1 corpse within 1.5 m for free
roll.useWhen: incoming telegraphed hit or hp < 40%; end next to a corpse when skeletons < cap

rankScaling.nc_torrent R1/R2 (36): 80% + slow to crossed enemies / +0.25 s, 6 essence each (<=18)

essence.valueNote: weapon% per essence spent on blight vs bonebolt, counting the essence the replaced bonebolt would have made
essence.reserveRule: essence never decays (only death empties it): bank out of combat. Keep 15 (one raise) in reserve while skeletons < cap; keep 30 (20 after golem R2) if golem is down; spend the rest on blight only when trigger met. With nc_hoard: never drop below 80+cost.
essence.income: bonebolt spam 6.94 essence/s at aps 1.25 (+6 per kill in 12 m, ~+2-4/s in packs) => ~9-11/s in pack combat, ~7/s single target

bestByCluster.assumptions: N enemies inside 1.8 m (all splash hit), corpsex with 2 corpses, sacrifice with 5 skeletons all in range, aps 1.25, lvl 9 ranks

N1.bestPerEssence: raise (if below cap and corpses) > blight (10.63%/essence) ; free skills (corpsex, sacrifice, colossus) cost 0: always fire when trigger met

N2.bestPerEssence: raise (if below cap and corpses) > blight (17.78%/essence) ; free skills (corpsex, sacrifice, colossus) cost 0: always fire when trigger met

N3.bestPerEssence: raise (if below cap and corpses) > blight (24.93%/essence) ; free skills (corpsex, sacrifice, colossus) cost 0: always fire when trigger met

N5.bestPerEssence: raise (if below cap and corpses) > blight (39.23%/essence) ; free skills (corpsex, sacrifice, colossus) cost 0: always fire when trigger met

bestByCluster.reading: colossus (cd 90) > corpsex (cd 8, needs corpses) > blight > sacrifice/bonebolt per cast-second; among spammables blight beats bonebolt at every N (1.8x at N1, 2.3x at N5); per essence: raise (~92%/ess while below cap) > blight (10.6 / 17.8 / 24.9 / 39.2 % per essence for N=1/2/3/5)

formula.hit: avgHit = ((wMin+flatDmg)+(wMax+flatDmg))/2 ; item dmg already includes upgrade (Pg: x(1+Eg[up]/100))
formula.execute: execF = 1 + 0.35*execute/100 (assumes ~35% of damage lands under 35% hp; ASSUMPTION) ; eliteDmg ~ +0.15*eliteDmg/100
formula.essence: gen = 1+(furyGen+0.5*(lvl-1)+0.5*wil)/100 ; income/s = (4*aps/0.72 + 2 kill)*gen ; surplus = income - 0.75 (raise upkeep)
formula.dpsIndex: dps = avgHit*dmgMult*critF*execF*(206.25*aps/0.72 + 8.44*surplus + 165)/100   [bonebolt spam scales with aps (dur/aps); 165%/s = 5 skeletons + corpsex, aps-independent]
formula.score: dps * sqrt(ehp)  -> compare items by swapping them into the full stat sheet; higher wins
formula.note: affix 'armor' is FLAT armor (added before %), not percent. Necro spenders blight/bonebolt use dur/aps (code), not sqrt: low-aps 2H staves do NOT favor necro casts; they only favor aps-independent damage (skeletons, golem, corpsex, colossus).

gear.weightsNote: % change of score per +1 of the stat, at lvl 9 with current weapon; flatDmg and dmgPct dominate, prec/critDmg/fer are weak until crit chance is higher

weaponBases.rule: only bases with cls necromancer (Ap list); all other weapons are blocked

colere_du_corbeau.warning: aps 0.92 matches no necro base (bonewand 1.25, deathstaff 0.9); 0.92 = firestaff (pyromancer) or greatsword (knight). Weapon base cls != necromancer cannot be equipped ($h rule). Check item.base first.

boots.note: vsCurrent here = vs wearing no boots (other gear armor assumed 20)

talentPlanReview.verdict: Mostly sound (army first, decrepify+golem choices fine). 4 swaps worth doing; row unlocks are Tf=[1,3,6,10,14,19,24,30,36,43,50], active rank N needs row level + 7*(N-1) (ult +8).

swaps.why: 4 corpses + blast 4.5 m = +33% corpsex damage and wider; marrow R1 is only +4% of your own hits
+20% dmg for you AND servants while essence > 80; essence never decays, so bank it (raise at >=95). One point beats marrow's 3 points (12%, self only)
4th slam (+33% ult = 1280%) and 6 corpses; plan never takes colossus R2
blight free (3 s cd): +1 corpse / 3 s for raise+corpsex and all essence goes to the army; bot has 0 deaths, so trade the 20% DR for kill speed. Revert if deaths appear

swaps.to: nc_marrow R2/R3 (the two points removed above)
swaps.why: +10% essence is worth ~1.3% score (furyGen weight 0.13/pt) vs +8% dmg
